releases.purpose: Sets up the foundation the next releases build on.

items.text: Apps are now plugins. What a plugin draws in a pane is a view.
Plexi checks for new builds and updates itself.
Nightly alpha builds for anyone who wants the newest work.
plexi plugin check points out layout problems before you share a plugin.
Groundwork for the permission system hardening that continues in the next releases.
Patch releases carry fixes as they are finished.

releases.forYou: You can install it today. It is an early beta for following along, so install only plugins you wrote or trust.

releases.purpose: One picker, built into Plexi, finds commands, files and agents.

items.text: The design of the shared picker.
Cmd+P opens commands. Tab moves to Files, then to Agents.
Files lists the files in your workspace, with a preview of text and images.
Agents shows each agent's state, whether it is waiting on you, and its latest message. Focus it, answer it or close it from there.
Commands that plugins add show up in the palette, labelled with their plugin.
Agents you define appear by name. Pick one and it picks up its last chat.
Permission system hardening continues.

releases.forYou: The picker is part of Plexi itself in this release. Plugins get to build on it in 0.7 Workbench. Still an early beta.

releases.title: 0.7 Workbench
releases.purpose: The first release meant for people who do not know me.

items.text: Views you keep open sit in a split beside your work. Quick ones open in a small window on top.
Notes becomes a plugin, built on the same tools any plugin author gets.
A Plugins manager for turning plugins on and off.
Spellcheck for the file you have open.
Plugins can use the picker.
Each plugin gets one defined place to keep its saved data.
One permission broker: every request for access goes through the same place.
Code identity: Plexi and the plugins you approve are signed and identified, so a permission stays with the code you gave it to.
A walkthrough of twelve everyday steps passes on a fresh install.

releases.forYou: When you upgrade, Plexi asks you once to approve your plugins again.

releases.title: 0.8 Writing Desk
releases.purpose: A text editor built into Plexi that plugins can extend.

items.text: A text editor in Plexi itself, with a place for plugins to add to it.
Tabs for working across several files.
Undo that works across Plexi.
Images attached to notes show in the notes preview.
Install plugins other people wrote.
The Explorer rebuilt as a plugin that ships with Plexi.
Builds signed and notarized by Apple.
A published licence for the code.

releases.title: After 1.0
releases.purpose: Work that waits until 1.0 is out.

items.text: The Assistant, an agent that can work across all of Plexi.
Windows and Linux.
A sandbox for the agents you run.
A whiteboard: a drawing plugin on the canvas. Opening .excalidraw files is a goal.
